title: The Perpetual Lounge

features.name: music-player
features.desc-on-touch: A device that plays a song no one chose. The music has been playing for so long that it has become the room itself. You've forgotten where the speaker is.

features.name: empty-register
features.desc-on-touch: A desk where guests sign in and out, except no one ever leaves. The pages are filled with names in handwriting that all looks the same. All arrivals, no departures.

features.name: waiting-chair
features.desc-on-touch: A chair that remembers every person who sat in it and forgot to leave. The cushion holds the shape of a thousand waits. You could sit and listen to the music forever.

inscription: the music has been playing so long that forgetting to leave has become the only arrival that counts

file.name: Motel_Lobby_Background_Music_Rec_1984.mp3
file.note: A single song looped for 40 years; the file format has corrupted but the song continues; what's playing may not be what was recorded

reverie.title: REVERIE — sitting in the motel where time has learned to wai
narr: She sits across from you in the lobby where the music
never stops. You are both pretending to wait for a bus
that has already come and gone. The song is playing
for the fourth or fifth time and she still hums along
as if she has never heard it before. This is kindness,
she says. Pretending the arrival is still to come.

exits.label: back into the grove where the world forgets itself
toward other rooms where the music keeps playing
into a silence that sounds like the music's opposite
